value: Finding the next viable market for a growing enterprise.

name: method
value: A stylised monthly enterprise with 1,200 units of demand at a price of $120, fixed costs of $29,000, constant demand elasticity and productivity reducing variable unit cost.

name: formula
value: Units = 1200 × (price/120)^(−elasticity); effective cost = variable cost/(1+productivity); profit = units × (price−effective cost) − 29000; break-even units = ceil(29000/contribution) when contribution > 0.

name: limits
value: Demand and cost assumptions are synthetic. No taxes, credit, competitors or capacity constraints are modelled. Nonpositive unit contribution means break-even is unattainable under these assumptions.

name: parameter_origin
value: Original stylised enterprise assumptions; no company observations supplied.

value: None supplied; no fitted coefficients or observed outcome dataset
